entries.en: The jar of acidum aceticum stood behind the balance in the old pharmacy display.
entries.zh: 在那间旧药房的陈列中，醋酸罐放在天平后面。

entries.en: The specialist compared the two reports of aciduria before speaking with the patient.
entries.zh: 专科医生先比较了两份关于酸尿的报告，再与患者交谈。

entries.en: She balanced the acidy filling with a sweeter pastry crust.
entries.zh: 她用更甜的酥皮来调和微酸的馅料。

entries.en: The acidyl group was missing from the structure she had copied onto the board.
entries.zh: 她抄到黑板上的结构式漏掉了酰基。

entries.en: Nobody could account for the missing acifluorfen sample when the shipment was unpacked.
entries.zh: 拆开那批货时，谁也说不清那份不见了的氟锁草醚样品去了哪里。

entries.en: Her drawing of the acinaceous fruit showed each seed separately.
entries.zh: 她画的多籽果实图把每一粒种子都单独画了出来。

entries.en: An acinaciform leaf lay across the margin of her botanical drawing.
entries.zh: 一片弯刀状的叶子横放在她的植物绘图边缘。

entries.en: The patient described his acinesis with the help of a notebook his family had brought.
entries.zh: 患者借助家人带来的笔记本，描述了自己运动不能的情况。

entries.en: The old case report described an acinetic patient but included no examination notes.
entries.zh: 那份旧病例报告描述了一位运动不能的患者，却没有附上检查记录。

entries.en: The laboratory's comparison of Acinetobacter isolates remained unfinished when the freezer failed.
entries.zh: 冷冻柜出故障时，实验室对不动细菌属分离株的比较尚未完成。

entries.en: The acininodular pattern was clearer in the enlarged image than in the small print.
entries.zh: 放大图像中的腺泡结节形态比小幅印片中的更清楚。

entries.en: The two reports disagreed about the extent of the acinitis.
entries.zh: 两份报告对腺泡炎涉及的范围记载不一。

entries.en: The curator found the Acinonychinae drawings in a box of unsorted zoological prints.
entries.zh: 策展人在一箱尚未分类的动物学版画中，找到了那些猎豹亚科的绘图。

entries.en: The artist redrew the acinotubular gland after noticing a gap in the outline.
entries.zh: 发现轮廓有一处断线后，绘图员重画了那幅管状腺泡腺体图。

entries.en: The historian compared two early reports on acipenserine before tracing their surviving laboratory notebooks.
entries.zh: 历史学家先比较了两份关于鲟精蛋白的早期报告，再追查留存的实验记录本。

entries.en: The actor studied the painting of Acis before the first rehearsal.
entries.zh: 第一次排练前，那位演员仔细看了描绘埃西斯的画。

entries.en: The pharmacist noticed that acitretin was missing from the printed inventory.
entries.zh: 药剂师发现打印的库存清单漏列了阿维A。

entries.en: The aclacinomycin measurements disagreed even after both analysts checked their calculations.
entries.zh: 即使两名分析员都检查了计算，阿克拉霉素的测定数据仍然不一致。

entries.en: A dark stain obscured part of the Acladium illustration in the old atlas.
entries.zh: 旧图谱中的一块深色污渍遮住了部分皮疡真菌属插图。

entries.en: The physicians discussed the child's aclasis privately while the family waited outside.
entries.zh: 家人在外面等候时，医生们私下讨论了孩子的续连症。

entries.meaningZh: 无倾角的〔用于 aclinic line〕
entries.en: The aclinic line was difficult to trace on the water-damaged magnetic chart.
entries.zh: 那张受水损坏的磁场图上，无磁倾角线很难辨认。

entries.meaningZh: 存取控制登记与报告〔缩写ACLR〕
entries.en: The missing ACLR records complicated the investigation into the unauthorized access.
entries.zh: 不见了的存取控制登记与报告记录，使未经授权访问事件的调查变得复杂。

entries.en: The museum stored its older Acmaeidae specimens in a separate cabinet.
entries.zh: 博物馆把较旧的笠贝科标本存放在单独的柜子里。

entries.en: The editor returned the Acmeist's poems with a request for clearer handwriting.
entries.zh: 编辑退回了那位阿克梅派诗人的诗稿，请求把字写得更清楚些。

entries.meaningZh: 自动通信和信息处理系统〔ACMPS系统名〕
entries.en: The instructor postponed the ACMPS demonstration when the projector failed.
entries.zh: 投影仪出故障后，讲师推迟了自动通信和信息处理系统的演示。

entries.en: The editor removed an unsupported claim about the cream's acnegenic effects.
entries.zh: 编辑删掉了关于那款面霜致痤疮作用的一条无依据说法。

entries.en: The revised article withdrew its claim that the unidentified residue was acneigenic.
entries.zh: 修订后的文章撤回了关于那份成分不明残留物会致痤疮的说法。

entries.en: The old photograph showed his acnemia more clearly than the faded clinical sketch.
entries.zh: 那张旧照片比褪色的临床素描更清楚地显示了他的腓肠部萎缩症。

entries.en: She described the acoasma reluctantly, worried that no one would take her account seriously.
entries.zh: 她不情愿地描述了自己的幻听，担心没有人会认真对待她的叙述。

entries.en: The missing acocantherin vial was found beneath an unopened parcel.
entries.zh: 那只不见了的东非箭毒树苷小瓶在一个尚未拆开的包裹下面被找到了。

entries.en: The Acoela specimens were moved while the museum repaired their storage cabinet.
entries.zh: 博物馆维修存放柜时，把那些无体腔目标本移走了。

entries.en: A page of Acoelea drawings had come loose from the old zoological atlas.
entries.zh: 旧动物学图谱中一页无腔目绘图脱落了。

entries.en: The damaged illustration of an acoelius was excluded from the exhibition catalogue.
entries.zh: 那幅受损的无腹畸胎插图没有收入展览目录。

entries.en: The curator searched for the Acoelomata collection while the gallery was closed for repairs.
entries.zh: 展厅关闭维修期间，策展人寻找那批无腔亚部藏品。

entries.en: The illustrator's acoelomate animal remained unfinished because the reference photograph was missing.
entries.zh: 由于参考照片不见了，插画师笔下的那只无体腔动物始终没有画完。

entries.en: The diagram's acoelous animal was enlarged so that the class could examine its outline.
entries.zh: 图中的无体腔动物被放大了，以便全班观察它的轮廓。

entries.en: The clinician listened carefully to her description of acoenesthesia without interrupting.
entries.zh: 临床医生认真听她描述存在感觉缺失，没有打断。

entries.en: They disagreed about the acofriose result because the instruments had been calibrated on different days.
entries.zh: 他们对鼠李糖-3-甲醚的结果有不同意见，因为仪器是在不同日期校准的。

entries.en: A courier returned the acokantherin sample after discovering that its destination label was unreadable.
entries.zh: 快递员发现目的地标签无法辨认后，退回了那份箭毒木甙样品。

entries.meaningZh: 阿科拉克〔维生素A胶囊剂商品名〕
entries.en: The old pharmacy display included an unopened box of Acolake beside a handwritten invoice.
entries.zh: 旧药房陈列中有一盒未拆封的阿科拉克，旁边放着一张手写发票。

entries.en: In the old tale, his acolasia drove away the friends who had once welcomed him.
entries.zh: 在那个旧故事里，他的放纵赶走了曾经欢迎他的朋友们。

entries.meaningZh: 低熔合金〔牙科材料 acolite〕
entries.en: An old dental fitting made from acolite was missing from the collection returned by the museum.
entries.zh: 博物馆归还的藏品中，少了一件用低熔合金制成的旧牙科配件。

entries.en: Her interest in acology began with the medical books she found in the library.
entries.zh: 她在图书馆找到的医学书籍，使她开始对治疗学产生兴趣。

entries.en: The acolous figure in the old medical drawing was partly obscured by a fold.
entries.zh: 那幅旧医学绘图中的无肢形象被折痕遮住了一部分。

entries.meaningZh: 自动编码系统〔ACOM旧系统名〕
entries.en: The archivist found the missing ACOM documentation inside a box of unsorted training materials.
entries.zh: 档案管理员在一箱尚未整理的培训资料中，找到了不见了的自动编码系统文档。

entries.en: The reference photograph of Acomatacarus was missing, so she left the drawing unfinished.
entries.zh: 多齿恙螨属的参考照片不见了，所以她没有完成绘图。

entries.en: Her acomia bothered her less than the way strangers stared.
entries.zh: 相比无发本身，她更在意陌生人盯着看的目光。

entries.en: The sculptor made the acomous head slightly larger than in the preliminary drawing.
entries.zh: 雕塑家把无发的头部做得比初步绘图中的略大。

entries.en: The aconate sample was returned because its accompanying document belonged to a different shipment.
entries.zh: 那份阿康酸盐样品被退回了，因为随附文件属于另一批货。

entries.en: The observer separated the aconative movements from those he believed were deliberate.
entries.zh: 观察者把非意志性动作与他认为是有意做出的动作区分开。

entries.en: The old aconine sample remained unopened while the laboratory checked the damaged paperwork.
entries.zh: 实验室核对受损文件期间，那份旧乌头胺样品一直没有打开。

entries.en: The revised report left the aconitase measurements unchanged but added the missing units.
entries.zh: 修订后的报告保留了原来的顺乌头酸酶测定数据，但补上了缺少的单位。

entries.en: One of the aconitate salts was missing from the set sent for comparison.
entries.zh: 送去比较的一组乌头酸盐中少了一种。

entries.en: The aconitic specimens were kept with the botanical drawings rather than the pharmacy collection.
entries.zh: 乌头植物标本与植物绘图保存在一起，而没有放入药房藏品中。

entries.en: The laboratory rejected the aconitine measurements because the reference vial's seal had been broken.
entries.zh: 由于对照品小瓶的封口已被破坏，实验室没有接受乌头碱的测定结果。

entries.meaningZh: 建立异步控制台命令〔ACONSOLE命令名〕
entries.en: The old handbook's ACONSOLE screenshot was too blurred to reproduce in the exhibition catalogue.
entries.zh: 旧手册中的ACONSOLE命令截图太模糊，无法翻印到展览图录中。

entries.en: The Aconta illustrations had been bound with the glossary instead of the main plates.
entries.zh: 那些红藻插图被装订在词汇表中，而没有放在主要图版部分。

entries.en: He asked the doctor to omit the aconuresis report from the letter intended for his employer.
entries.zh: 他请医生不要把小便失禁的报告内容写进准备寄给雇主的信。

entries.en: The acoprous intestine was only partly visible in the damaged plate.
entries.zh: 受损图版中只能看到部分空虚的肠管。

entries.en: Her acoria left her without a sense of satiety even after the meal.
entries.zh: 由于不饱症，她即使吃过饭仍没有饱腹感。

entries.en: The acorin analysis had been interrupted before the damaged instrument was replaced.
entries.zh: 受损仪器更换之前，菖蒲苷的分析就已中断。

entries.meaningZh: 无躯干畸胎〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The damaged plate showed an acormus, but the accompanying notes were missing.
entries.zh: 那张受损的图版展示了一例无躯干畸胎，但配套笔记不见了。

entries.en: She wanted a second opinion about the acosmia before travelling abroad.
entries.zh: 她想在出国前，就病程异常再寻求一次诊疗意见。

entries.en: The anatomist compared the acostate model with an undamaged example from the same collection.
entries.zh: 解剖学家把无肋模型与同一收藏中一个完好的模型作了比较。

entries.en: He hesitated before telling the physician about the acouasm that had disturbed his sleep.
entries.zh: 他犹豫了一下，才把影响睡眠的幻听告诉医生。

entries.en: The acouchi vanished behind the fallen log before I could focus the camera.
entries.zh: 我还没调好相机焦点，那只长尾刺鼠就消失在倒下的树干后面。

entries.en: She found it difficult to describe the change in her acouesthesia without using everyday examples.
entries.zh: 不用日常例子，她很难描述自己听觉的变化。

entries.en: The curator returned the acoumeter to its padded case after the visitors had left.
entries.zh: 参观者离开后，策展人把测听计放回了有衬垫的盒子里。

entries.en: The second acoumetry session was interrupted by noise from the building work.
entries.zh: 施工噪声打断了第二次听力测验。

entries.en: A crack in the acouometer's outer case delayed its loan to the exhibition.
entries.zh: 听力计外壳上的裂纹使这件仪器的借展推迟了。

entries.en: The museum borrowed an acouophone from a private collection for its exhibition.
entries.zh: 博物馆从私人收藏中借来一件助听器用于展览。

entries.en: The acouoxylon was still wrapped in the cloth used to protect it during the move.
entries.zh: 那件木制听诊器还包在搬迁时用于保护它的布里。

entries.en: The acousimeter was missing from the equipment list, though it appeared in the photograph.
entries.zh: 设备清单漏列了测声计，尽管照片中能看到它。

entries.en: She brought a written account of her acousmatagnosis to the appointment.
entries.zh: 她就诊时带去了自己关于辨音不能情况的书面叙述。

entries.en: He wanted his own account of the acousmatamnesia included alongside the examiner's notes.
entries.zh: 他希望把自己对听觉性健忘的叙述与检查者的笔记一同保存。

entries.en: The museum's Acousticon hearing aid was returned in a case that belonged to a different exhibit.
entries.zh: 博物馆的Acousticon助听器归还时，装在了属于另一个展品的盒子里。

entries.en: The museum's acoutometer was photographed before being packed for the travelling exhibition.
entries.zh: 博物馆的听力计在为巡回展装箱之前拍了照。

entries.meaningZh: 计算机程序员和分析员协会〔ACPA〕
entries.en: The archivist kept the ACPA membership letters in a separate folder.
entries.zh: 档案管理员把计算机程序员和分析员协会的会员信件保存在单独的文件夹里。

entries.en: The ACPP measurement was missing from the table sent to the reviewer.
entries.zh: 寄给审阅者的表格漏掉了肾上腺皮质多肽的测定数据。

entries.en: She circled Acrab on her star chart before passing it to the next student.
entries.zh: 她在星图上圈出房宿四，再把图递给下一个学生。

entries.en: The historian requested the original acraldehyde records rather than relying on the typed summary.
entries.zh: 历史学家要求查阅丙烯醛的原始记录，而不是依赖那份打字摘要。

entries.en: The container of acramine arrived without the paperwork that should have accompanied it.
entries.zh: 装盐酸氨基吖啶的容器送到时，没有附上应随货提供的文件。

entries.en: The illustration of acrania was removed from the public display at the family's request.
entries.zh: 应家属要求，那幅无颅畸形插图被撤下，不再公开展示。

entries.en: The older atlas included a small drawing of an acranial specimen.
entries.zh: 较早的图谱中收有一幅无颅标本的小绘图。

entries.en: The Acranil delivery arrived at the old laboratory after its storage rooms had been emptied.
entries.zh: 氯甲氧吖胺送到旧实验室时，那里的储藏室已经清空。

entries.en: The damaged photograph of an acranius could not be included in the teaching collection.
entries.zh: 那张受损的无颅畸胎照片无法收入教学藏品。

entries.en: The older Acrasiales collection was listed separately from the recently reorganized specimens.
entries.zh: 较早的集胞粘菌目收藏被单独列出，没有与近期重新整理的标本列在一起。

entries.en: The figure comparing acrasinase activity was illegible in the photocopy.
entries.zh: 复印件中那幅比较集胞粘菌素酶活性的图看不清楚。

entries.en: She left her drawing of the Acrasis specimen unfinished when the reference slide went missing.
entries.zh: 参考玻片不见后，她没有完成那幅宿曲滴菌标本图。

entries.en: Her acratia made even the short walk to the waiting room exhausting.
entries.zh: 她因无力，连走到候诊室这一小段路都觉得疲惫不堪。

entries.en: He found it easier to discuss his acraturesis when the interpreter had left.
entries.zh: 口译员离开后，他觉得更容易开口谈论自己的排尿无力。

entries.en: The unopened Acrawax package was returned because the order number belonged to another customer.
entries.zh: 那包尚未拆封的阿克蜡被退回了，因为订单号属于另一位客户。

entries.en: The atlas's Acremoniella illustration had been printed upside down.
entries.zh: 图谱中的小支顶孢属插图印倒了。

entries.en: She brought the earlier acremoniosis records to the consultation in a separate envelope.
entries.zh: 她把先前的支顶孢病记录装在单独的信封里，带去会诊。

entries.en: The photograph of the Acremonium specimens was too dark to reproduce clearly.
entries.zh: 支顶孢属标本的照片太暗，无法清楚地翻印。

entries.en: A damaged storage case prevented the curator from displaying the old acribometer.
entries.zh: 精微测量器的盒子损坏了，策展人无法将这件旧仪器展出。

entries.en: The museum kept the acrichine package with the pharmacist's letters rather than the display bottles.
entries.zh: 博物馆把阿的平包装与药剂师的信件保存在一起，而没有和陈列瓶放在一起。

entries.en: The supplier's letter explained why the acridan sample had been returned unopened.
entries.zh: 供应商的信说明了那份9,10-二氢化吖啶样品为何被原封不动地退回。

entries.en: An unexpected peak complicated her analysis of the acridine sample.
entries.zh: 一个意外的峰使她对吖啶样品的分析变得复杂。

entries.en: The acridinyl group in her drawing was shaded differently from the rest of the molecule.
entries.zh: 她图中的吖啶基采用了与分子其余部分不同的阴影画法。

entries.en: The remaining acridol was reserved for the second comparison, which was later cancelled.
entries.zh: 剩余的吖啶酚留给了第二次比较，但那次比较后来取消了。

entries.en: The archived acridostibine results were missing the page that identified the samples.
entries.zh: 归档的吖啶锑结果缺少了标明样品身份的那一页。

entries.en: The analyst had mistaken a photocopy of the acriflavine spectrum for the original.
entries.zh: 分析员把吖啶黄谱图的复印件误当成了原件。

entries.en: The acrinyl group was drawn separately because the main diagram had become crowded.
entries.zh: 由于主图已显拥挤，羟苄基被单独画了出来。

entries.en: The acrisorcin shipment was delayed after the address on the consignment was found to be incomplete.
entries.zh: 发现货物上的地址不完整后，吖啶琐辛的运输延误了。

entries.en: The damaged box contained the acritol sample, not the replacement glassware everyone had expected.
entries.zh: 那个破损的盒子里是吖糖醇样品，并不是大家预期的替换玻璃器皿。

entries.en: She struggled to explain her acro-agnosis to someone who had never experienced it.
entries.zh: 她很难向从未经历过肢体感缺失的人解释自己的感受。

entries.en: His acro-arthritis troubled him throughout the journey, though he said little about it.
entries.zh: 肢关节炎在整个旅途中困扰着他，但他很少谈起。

entries.en: The earlier acro-asphyxia photographs were missing when she requested a copy of her records.
entries.zh: 她申请复制自己的病历时，先前的肢端缺氧照片不见了。

entries.en: Her account of acro-ataxia focused on the everyday tasks she now found difficult.
entries.zh: 她叙述肢端共济失调时，着重谈了自己现在觉得困难的日常活动。

entries.en: He worried that strangers would notice his acro-edema at the family gathering.
entries.zh: 他担心家庭聚会上不认识的人会注意到自己的肢肿症。

entries.en: The atlas's illustration of acrocephalia had been cut out before the library acquired the book.
entries.zh: 图书馆收藏那本图谱之前，其中的尖头畸形插图就已被剪掉。

entries.en: The older report on acrocephalosyndactylia was absent from the documents sent to her physician.
entries.zh: 寄给她的医生的文件中，缺少了先前关于尖头并指（趾）畸形的报告。

entries.en: She wanted her own account of living with acrocephalosyndactyly included in the exhibition.
entries.zh: 她希望展览收录自己与尖头并指（趾）畸形共同生活的叙述。

entries.en: The acrochordon was barely visible in the photograph she brought to the appointment.
entries.zh: 她就诊时带来的照片中，几乎看不清那个软垂疣。

entries.en: The jaw's acrodont dentition was difficult to make out in the faded photograph.
entries.zh: 褪色的照片中很难辨认那副颌骨的颌缘着齿结构。

entries.en: He chose an acrodrome leaf for the drawing, but its tip broke off before he finished.
entries.zh: 他选了一片叶脉向尖聚集的叶子作画，但还没画完，叶尖就折断了。

entries.en: Her acrodynia made it hard to concentrate on the conversation around her.
entries.zh: 肢端痛使她难以专心听周围的谈话。

entries.en: The older Acrogenus records were stored separately from the recent plant-virus photographs.
entries.zh: 较早的纤瘦病毒属记录与近期的植物病毒照片分开保存。

entries.en: She asked that the photograph showing her acrogeria not be included in the exhibition.
entries.zh: 她要求不要把那张显示自己肢皮早老情况的照片收入展览。

entries.en: She described her acrognosis carefully, distinguishing it from the pain she had felt earlier.
entries.zh: 她仔细描述了自己的肢体感觉，将它与先前的疼痛区分开。

entries.en: Her acrohyperhidrosis made the paper in her hands noticeably damp.
entries.zh: 她的手足多汗使手里那张纸明显变潮了。

entries.en: The patient was more concerned about her repeated acrohypothermy than about the missing appointment letter.
entries.zh: 比起不见了的预约信，那位患者更担心自己反复出现的手足温度过低。

entries.en: The consultation about her acromegalogigantism lasted longer than she had expected.
entries.zh: 关于她肢端巨大性巨大畸形的会诊比她预想的持续得更久。

entries.en: He kept the photographs documenting his acromegaloidism in a private folder.
entries.zh: 他把记录自己类肢端巨大症情况的照片放在私人文件夹中。

entries.en: During the journey, his acromelalgia was harder for him to ignore than the noisy engine.
entries.zh: 旅途中，比起吵闹的发动机，他更难忽视自己的红斑性肢痛病。

entries.en: The acromelic changes were clearer in the later photograph, though its date was missing.
entries.zh: 较后一张照片中的肢端变化更清楚，但照片日期不见了。

entries.en: The acromioclavicular region was partly hidden by the folded edge of the photograph.
entries.zh: 照片折起的边缘遮住了部分肩锁区域。

entries.en: She enlarged the acromiocoracoid part of the drawing before tracing the outline.
entries.zh: 她先放大绘图中的肩峰喙突部分，再描出轮廓。

entries.en: The second image showed the acromiohumeral interval more clearly than the first.
entries.zh: 第二张图像比第一张更清楚地显示了肩峰肱骨间隙。

entries.en: The illustrator left the acromioscapular outline unfinished when the reference sheet went missing.
entries.zh: 参考纸页不见后，绘图员没有完成肩峰肩胛部分的轮廓。

entries.en: The acromiothoracic area was outside the photograph's frame.
entries.zh: 肩峰胸廓区域没有进入照片画面。

entries.en: The older case notes on acromycosis were missing from the file sent to the physician.
entries.zh: 寄给医生的档案里缺少了先前关于四肢真菌病的病例记录。

entries.en: The supplier offered to replace the damaged Acron pieces rather than repair them.
entries.zh: 供应商提出更换受损的阿克隆铝铜硅合金件，而不是修理它们。

entries.meaningZh: 辛辣麻醉的〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: In the old story, the acronarcotic preparation was missing from the physician's medicine chest.
entries.zh: 在那个旧故事里，医生药箱中的辛辣麻醉制剂不见了。

entries.en: She chose to discuss her acroneuropathy privately after the rest of the group had left.
entries.zh: 小组其他人离开后，她选择私下谈谈自己的肢端神经病。

entries.en: The patient's acropachy was visible in the photograph, but the date had been cut away.
entries.zh: 照片中能看出患者的杵状指，但日期被裁掉了。

entries.en: He brought photographs of his acropachyderma to the consultation because the earlier file was missing.
entries.zh: 由于先前的档案不见了，他带着自己肢厚皮病的照片前来会诊。

entries.en: His acroparalysis prevented him from turning the heavy key.
entries.zh: 他的肢麻痹使他无法转动那把沉重的钥匙。

entries.en: She found her acroparesthesia distracting while trying to write a letter.
entries.zh: 她想写信时，觉得肢端感觉异常让自己难以专心。

entries.en: His acropathy was mentioned in the referral, but the earlier examination notes were missing.
entries.zh: 转诊信提到了他的四肢病，但先前的检查记录不见了。

entries.en: The acropeptide analysis was postponed because the archived sample could not be located.
entries.zh: 由于找不到那份归档保存的样品，无色肽的分析推迟了。

entries.en: The physician explained the acroposthitis report privately rather than discussing it in the corridor.
entries.zh: 医生私下解释了那份包皮炎报告，没有在走廊里讨论。

entries.en: In the old case history, he described how acrorrheuma had disrupted his work.
entries.zh: 在那份旧病史中，他描述了肢风湿病如何打乱自己的工作。

entries.en: The museum's Acrosaleniidae specimens remained in storage while their cabinet was being repaired.
entries.zh: 存放柜维修期间，博物馆的顶萨列海胆科标本仍保存在库房中。

entries.en: The two photographs of acroscleroderma had been filed under different patient numbers.
entries.zh: 那两张肢硬皮病照片被归在不同的患者编号之下。

entries.en: Her acrosclerosis was the subject she found hardest to discuss during the appointment.
entries.zh: 就诊时，肢端硬化病是她最难开口谈及的问题。

entries.en: Her analysis of the acrose sample remained unfinished when the instrument was sent away for repair.
entries.zh: 仪器送修时，她对那份阿柯糖样品的分析尚未完成。

entries.en: The laboratory's acrosin measurements could not be compared because one table lacked units.
entries.zh: 由于一张表格缺少单位，实验室的精子酵素测定结果无法比较。

entries.en: The acrosite specimen arrived without the photograph that was meant to accompany it.
entries.zh: 硫锑银矿标本送到时，没有附上本应随附的照片。

entries.en: The enlarged image showed the acrosomal region, but its outer edge was blurred.
entries.zh: 放大图像显示出顶体区域，但其外缘模糊不清。

entries.en: She drew an acrospore separately from the main cluster to make its outline clear.
entries.zh: 她把一枚顶端孢子与主要那一簇分开画，以清楚显示其轮廓。

entries.en: The damaged acrosternite was not visible in the specimen photograph.
entries.zh: 标本照片中看不到受损的端腹片。

entries.en: The old acrosyl bottle still had its stopper, but the accompanying receipt was missing.
entries.zh: 那只旧煤酚皂溶液瓶还保留着瓶塞，但随附的收据不见了。

entries.en: The photograph of the acroteben container was too blurred to settle the inventory dispute.
entries.zh: 羟苄异烟腙容器的照片太模糊，无法解决库存争议。

entries.en: The old illustration showed acroteric changes but gave no indication of their extent.
entries.zh: 那幅旧插图显示了末梢变化，却没有说明其涉及范围。

entries.en: The drawing showed an acrothymion that the accompanying photograph had failed to capture clearly.
entries.zh: 绘图显示出一个尖疣，随附照片却没能把它拍清楚。

entries.en: The old case history described an acrotic patient but omitted the observer's name.
entries.zh: 那份旧病史描述了一名无脉患者，却漏记了观察者的姓名。

entries.en: The disputed account of acrotism was reviewed alongside the original examination notes.
entries.zh: 那份受到质疑的无脉情况叙述与原始检查笔记一起接受了复核。

entries.en: She borrowed the older Acrotretacea collection for a comparison that was later cancelled.
entries.zh: 她借来了那批较早的顶孔贝科收藏，用于一次后来取消的比较。

entries.en: The Acrotretidina specimens occupied the drawer above the maps, not the one below them.
entries.zh: 顶孔亚目标本放在地图上方的抽屉里，而不是下方的抽屉。

entries.en: She spoke about her acrotrophodynia only after the recorder had been switched off.
entries.zh: 录音机关闭后，她才谈起自己的营养性肢痛症。

entries.en: He was relieved to discuss his acrotrophoneurosis without the other visitors listening.
entries.zh: 能够在没有其他来访者旁听的情况下谈论肢营养神经病，他感到宽慰。

entries.en: Clouds hid Acrux before she could complete her sketch of the sky.
entries.zh: 她还没画完天空速写，云就遮住了Acrux星。

entries.meaningZh: Acrylite 聚丙烯酸酯塑料〔商品名〕
entries.en: A damaged corner prevented the designer from using the Acrylite panel in the display.
entries.zh: 由于一角受损，设计师无法在展示中使用那块Acrylite塑料板。

entries.en: The Acryloid sample was missing from the parcel, though its accompanying invoice was enclosed.
entries.zh: 包裹里少了Acryloid丙烯酸剂样品，尽管随附发票已装在里面。

entries.en: A broken hinge prevented the curator from opening the case containing the acrylophenone bottle.
entries.zh: 铰链坏了，策展人无法打开装有苯丙烯酮瓶的盒子。

entries.en: The student omitted the acryloyl group when copying the structural drawing.
entries.zh: 学生临摹结构图时漏掉了丙烯酰基。

entries.en: Her sketch placed the acrylyl group on the wrong side of the diagram.
entries.zh: 她在草图中把丙烯酰基画到了错误的一侧。

entries.meaningZh: 联系控制服务元素〔缩写ACSE〕
entries.en: The engineers could not compare the two ACSE implementations because one report was incomplete.
entries.zh: 由于一份报告不完整，工程师们无法比较那两种联系控制服务元素的实现。

entries.meaningZh: 亚克托安〔希腊神话人物〕
entries.en: The museum borrowed an unfinished study of Actaeon for its drawing exhibition.
entries.zh: 博物馆为素描展借来了一幅尚未完成的亚克托安习作。

entries.en: The enlarged photograph of the Actaletidae specimens was missing from the exhibition catalogue.
entries.zh: 展览图录中缺少了滨跳虫科标本的放大照片。

entries.en: The actaplanin analysis remained unfinished when the laboratory closed for repairs.
entries.zh: 实验室关闭维修时，阿克他宁的分析尚未完成。

entries.en: The actargil consignment was returned after the laboratory discovered that its accompanying records were incomplete.
entries.zh: 实验室发现随附记录不完整后，退回了那批氯丙嗪。

entries.en: The Actidione sample arrived without the document identifying the batch it came from.
entries.zh: 放线菌酮样品送到时，没有附上标明其所属批次的文件。

entries.en: The two actinate samples could not be compared because one vial had been misplaced.
entries.zh: 由于一只小瓶放错了地方，那两份肌动蛋白化物样品无法比较。

entries.en: A discrepancy in the actiniasterol measurements led the chemist back to the original notebooks.
entries.zh: 海葵甾醇测定数据中的一处出入，促使化学家重新查阅原始记录本。

entries.en: The animal's actiniform outline was clearer in her sketch than in the blurred photograph.
entries.zh: 比起模糊的照片，她的速写更清楚地表现了那只动物的放射形轮廓。

entries.en: The actinin image had been cropped so tightly that the scale bar was missing.
entries.zh: 辅肌动蛋白图像裁剪得太紧，比例尺被裁掉了。

entries.en: Her actinine measurements were absent from the summary, though they remained in the original notebook.
entries.zh: 摘要中没有她的辅肌动蛋白测定数据，但原始记录本中仍保留着这些数据。

entries.en: The container of actiniohematin was placed on the wrong shelf during the move.
entries.zh: 搬迁时，装有海葵羟基血红素的容器被放错了架子。

entries.en: The actino-erythrin measurements were left out of the summary sent to the editor.
entries.zh: 寄给编辑的摘要漏掉了赤海葵红素的测定结果。
